text:
Marta: Quick check — onboarding zeta-20b weights. Where are the canonical HF repo and our S3 mirror? I need checksum + an owner so we can schedule the smoke canary tomorrow morning.
Cheng: HF path is hf://redwood/zeta-20b-v1. Mirror is s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-20b/v1/weights.pt. I uploaded a manifest at s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-20b/v1/manifest.json with sha256 fields.
Liam: Heads-up: tokenizer for this snapshot has a different BOS token id than our standard. Tokenizer lives at s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-20b/v1/tokenizer.json — I ran a quick decode check and saw mismatched start tokens which explains generation drift.
Marta: Who created the manifest, and can we set a human owner for followups? Also want to confirm quant config in the model_card.
Cheng: ingest-bot created the manifest, but we should assign @liam as the owner for onboarding. I can open a PR to add config.quant.bits=8 to model_card if needed.
ingest-bot: Manifest created by ingest-bot at 2149007700. Checksums: weights.sha256 = "3a7f8e9c...b2d1", tokenizer.sha256 = "9f1c2b4a...7e6f". Tags: [curated:onboarding]. Validation: weights size 27.3GB, object etag OK.
Ana: Can we add a small registry validation rule: manifest must have `author`, `checksum` and `quant` keys, plus tokenizer.bos mapping note. Filing infra issue #349 to track.
ops-sre: Permission note — current S3 prefix is private. Requesting read access for runtime-role-redwood-prod (ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/runtime-role-redwood-prod). Quick presign snippet you can use while IAM ticket is pending:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-artifacts/models/zeta-20b/v1/weights.pt --expires-in 3600 --region us-west-2
```
Cheng: IAM ticket submitted (ID #792). If approved I'll update manifest.s3_url to the us-west-2 signed URL and add region metadata.
Liam: I'll take ownership of the manifest and add a short test harness to verify tokenization parity + generation sanity (small prompt smoke). Will also add tokenizer mapping note in the model_card and a comment in the manifest for downstream.
Marta: Checklist for canary rollout tomorrow 10:00 PT:
- owner assigned -> liam
- checksum present in manifest -> yes (ingest-bot)
- tokenizer mapping note -> in progress (liam)
- IAM read grant -> pending (#792)
- presign + infra script -> cheng
- quant config -> cheng will add PR
If we hit all items by 9:30am PT, proceed with a 5% traffic canary. :thumbsup:
Liam: I'll post the PR and the harness link here once ready. Expect ~30m work.
Cheng: I'll prep the presign step and an infra snippet to be added to infra/recipes/presign.md.
Marta: Great — thanks. If IAM lingers @ops-sre can you escalate? We don't want the rollout blocked on perms. :eyes: 
ops-sre: Noted, will ping security and escalate if no action in 2 hours.
Marta: Perfect. Otherwise we'll go ahead with the canary if we have the signed URL.
Liam: +1. Will also include a note to revert to hf://redwood/zeta-20b-v0 if parity fails.
Marta: Thanks all — will check back at 9:15am PT.
